We are working with the lovely team at Raw Research casting an exciting ITV x PayPal Christmas campaign, and we’re looking for bubbly, fun-loving families (e.g. adult siblings, adults with their parents, couples with children aged 16+, friends and housemates who love Christmas and go the extra mile to make it memorable. We’re particularly keen to hear from adults in their 40s and 50s - though all ages are welcome.

You might be a couple with children aged 16 or older, adult siblings, or grown-up children celebrating with their parents. Whatever your set-up, we’d love to meet people who enjoy a laugh, love ITV and already have plans for this Christmas.

We are looking for people who are London-based or about 90 minutes outside of London.

Do you have a Christmas dilemma we could help with?
Perhaps your adult child has a new partner joining Christmas lunch and you have no idea what to buy them? Maybe you’re determined to surprise your mum or sibling but have run out of ideas? Or perhaps you want to make a friend’s Christmas extra special and need some inspiration!

We’d ideally spend a day filming at your home, having fun planning presents, putting up decorations and calling ITV for help with your Christmas dilemmas. There may even be a quiz about ITV presenters, so a love of ITV and a willingness to be a bit silly are essential!

Filming - Dates TBC but 5th or 6th OR 9th are 10th of November are likely.

Payment:
£350 per person, per filming day.
£2,000 per person if you appear in the final ad campaign.
£500 per household if filming takes place in your home.
Eligibility:
Everyone taking part must be aged 16 or over. Ideally adults in their 40s and 50s!
Participants must be eligible for a PayPal account and have used PayPal or be familiar with it.
Participants must have no adverse credit history, history of debt or financial vulnerability.
Participants must have no current or previous affiliations with competing financial brands.
Interested? Please contact casting@rawresearch.co.uk, telling us who you’d take part with, what makes Christmas special to you and the Christmas dilemma you’d love help with. Please also send a photo of everyone applying, a simple selfie will do!
Thank you

**CASTING! SZUKAMY AKTORÓW DO NOWEJ KOMEDII TEATRALNEJ!**

Pracujemy nad nowym spektaklem komediowym o młodym małżeństwie, codziennych absurdach życia we dwoje i problemach, które ciężko rozwiązać.

Poszukujemy charyzmatycznych aktorów z doskonałym wyczuciem komedii (nie musisz być profesjonalistą):
EWA (22-27 lat) - temperamentna, inteligentna, błyskotliwa. Kobieta z charakterem, ciętym językiem i doskonałym wyczuciem ironii.

ADAM (25–30 lat) - sympatyczny, sarkastyczny, nieco nieporadny życiowo. Mistrz wymówek i pakowania się w kłopoty. Najlepiej z lekkim brzuszkiem

KRZYSIEK (25–30 lat) - najlepszy kumpel Adama. Wygadany, pewny siebie, z talentem do pakowania innych w tarapaty.

Szukamy osób z dobrą energią sceniczną, świetnym timingiem komediowym, naturalnością w dialogach i swobodą w kontakcie z publicznością. Mile widziane doświadczenie w komedii, farsie oraz improwizacji.

JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Prześlij zdjęcie, krótką informację o sobie, doświadczenie aktorskie oraz wizytówkę (jeśli posiadasz) na adres: biuro@enemka.pl lub zgłoś się pod postem

Miejsce prób: Czechowice-Dziedzice/Bielsko-Biała

Termin realizacji: próby grudzień/styczeń; spektakle od stycznia do maja 2027
Wynagrodzenie: do ustalenia

Zgłoś się, może właśnie Ciebie zobaczymy na scenie!

SEEKING ROLES FOR A STUDENT SHORT FILM

The younger brother of the teen detective duo, The Patton Boys. Terry is incredibly intelligent but keeps an innocent and naive spirit. An all-American kid, he likes his apples as crisp as he likes his pie sweet.

Call for Participants: Staged Reading Theatre Workshop

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?

“Saving the Timothy” — A Modern Retelling of “A Christmas Carol”

The Recovered Arts Collective is seeking actors for an upcoming staged reading of Saving the Timothy, a new dramatic comedy written and directed by John-David Hutchison.

We also require Stage Manager, Assistant Director, Lighting & Sound Technicians

About the Project
We are bringing together a community of people with lived experience of addiction to participate in developing this new play. This project will culminate in a staged reading—a live performance where actors read the script with minimal sets, props, or costumes. Performers focus on character development, vocal expression, and text interpretation in a supportive, low-pressure environment.

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward 12-step redemption and sobriety.

Who Can Join & What to Expect
Inclusive Community: Everyone is welcome! Whether you are a seasoned creative or have never stepped foot on a stage before, no previous experience is required—just a willingness to share your story and connect.

Supportive Environment: A peer-led space focused on safety, creative expression, personal growth, and building lasting relationships.

Collaborative Process: Work together to bring personal and community stories to life, culminating in a public staged reading performance.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Rehearsals: Sundays (November 8, 15, 22, 29), 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Time TBD)
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Character Breakdown
Eban Miser: A once-prominent Broadway and Hollywood director who, after facing bankruptcy, career failure, and struggles with alcoholism and drug addiction, returns to his hometown to direct a local production of A Christmas Carol and undergoes a redemptive journey toward sobriety.

Jake O'Connor/The Ghost of Christmas Future: Eban's late business partner and co-founder of the Timothy Findley Theatre, who dies broke and unaccomplished, but happy and whose reanimated corpse warns Eban to change his destructive path.

Bob Cratchit: Eban's loyal and hardworking stage manager at the theatre, who later becomes an equal partner and helps care for Timothia.

Fred: Eban's cheerful and persistent nephew who repeatedly invites him to holiday gatherings and tries to show him goodwill.

Clara: Fred's wife and member of the theatre troupe

Bill (The Ghost of Christmas Past): A calm, guiding figure who leads Eban through his spectral journey 

Fan: Eban's late sister.

Mr. Fezziwig: Eban's enthusiastic high school gym teacher who features in his past memory of a school dance.

Patricia: Eban's former fiancée who broke off their relationship because he abandoned their shared values for the pursuit of wealth.

Belle: Eban's former partner who left him because of his unaddressed alcoholism.

Emily: Bob Cratchit's sharp-tongued wife who helps run the household and cares for Timothia.

Timothia: Jake’s sullen 15-year-old orphaned daughter who lives with Bob and Emily.

Jack: The abusive stepfather from Eban's childhood.

Craig: Belle's husband.

Nancy, Topper, and Friends: Members of the theatre troupe

Call for Participants: Staged Reading Theatre Workshop

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?

“Saving the Timothy” — A Modern Retelling of “A Christmas Carol”

The Recovered Arts Collective is seeking actors for an upcoming staged reading of Saving the Timothy, a new dramatic comedy written and directed by John-David Hutchison.

We also require Stage Manager, Assistant Director, Lighting & Sound Technicians

About the Project
We are bringing together a community of people with lived experience of addiction to participate in developing this new play. This project will culminate in a staged reading—a live performance where actors read the script with minimal sets, props, or costumes. Performers focus on character development, vocal expression, and text interpretation in a supportive, low-pressure environment.

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward 12-step redemption and sobriety.

Who Can Join & What to Expect
Inclusive Community: Everyone is welcome! Whether you are a seasoned creative or have never stepped foot on a stage before, no previous experience is required—just a willingness to share your story and connect.

Supportive Environment: A peer-led space focused on safety, creative expression, personal growth, and building lasting relationships.

Collaborative Process: Work together to bring personal and community stories to life, culminating in a public staged reading performance.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Rehearsals: Sundays (November 8, 15, 22, 29), 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Time TBD)
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Character Breakdown
Eban Miser: A once-prominent Broadway and Hollywood director who, after facing bankruptcy, career failure, and struggles with alcoholism and drug addiction, returns to his hometown to direct a local production of A Christmas Carol and undergoes a redemptive journey toward sobriety.

Jake O'Connor/The Ghost of Christmas Future: Eban's late business partner and co-founder of the Timothy Findley Theatre, who dies broke and unaccomplished, but happy and whose reanimated corpse warns Eban to change his destructive path.

Bob Cratchit: Eban's loyal and hardworking stage manager at the theatre, who later becomes an equal partner and helps care for Timothia.

Fred: Eban's cheerful and persistent nephew who repeatedly invites him to holiday gatherings and tries to show him goodwill.

Clara: Fred's wife and member of the theatre troupe

Bill (The Ghost of Christmas Past): A calm, guiding figure who leads Eban through his spectral journey 

Fan: Eban's late sister.

Mr. Fezziwig: Eban's enthusiastic high school gym teacher who features in his past memory of a school dance.

Patricia: Eban's former fiancée who broke off their relationship because he abandoned their shared values for the pursuit of wealth.

Belle: Eban's former partner who left him because of his unaddressed alcoholism.

Emily: Bob Cratchit's sharp-tongued wife who helps run the household and cares for Timothia.

Timothia: Jake’s sullen 15-year-old orphaned daughter who lives with Bob and Emily.

Jack: The abusive stepfather from Eban's childhood.

Craig: Belle's husband.

Nancy, Topper, and Friends: Members of the theatre troupe
Roastmaster and 3 Roast Comics: Roasters of Eban (These four roles are specifically for comedians who will assist in the writing of the roast dialogue.)

Jigsaw Casting is seeking Canadian User -generated videos that show a ‘winning moment’ in life for a LOTTO 649 campaign done through TBWA\Canada (address: 219 Dufferin Street, Suite 302C, Toronto, ON, M6K 3J1/Tel: 416.483.3600/[https://tbwa.ca/](https://tbwa.ca/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFaZzlmNFdiS1JOMTRibVNkc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHifDGia4LsOANDG_Ih2ltQT9AaeTz2u2uhuNe4hNlIgkWLvv1Kcxh0Qp2M2Z_aem_X_R1CiZkB1duyws1Eg9Ziw)) (Excludes submissions from the province of Quebec)

We are looking for those moments that feel like someone is coming out on top. Your video clips should have a range of emotions. Some are fist pumping celebrations (i.e. catching a baseball). Others are beautiful, heartfelt moments (i.e. someone asking out his crush and getting her number, or someone getting married and it was a very emotional romantic moment).

We’ll prioritize a broad range of Canadian experiences and affinities, from fishing and outdoor activities to sports, city moments, friendships, family and romantic relationships.

Canadian-shot content only: All footage must be filmed in Canada. Canadian creators are preferred, and recognizable non-Canadian locations/backdrops should be avoided. Generic footage from a Canadian creator that does not reveal an identifiable foreign location may be considered subject to client approval.

What we are looking for:

Our clips also fall into two camps: The Win and The Agency.

The Win
This shows the moment people come out on top.
For example:
→ Pulling a giant trout from the water
→ Catching a home run baseball in the stands

The Agency
This shows a moment of doubt, hesitation, or choice.
→ A moment before their hole-in-one swing, a friend saying they can’t make the shot.
→ Someone getting egged on before they go on stage and slay at karaoke.
→ Someone is deliberating doing that cliff dive. Do they vs don’t they.

If you have another footage that is a wild card, it may not fit the above specs, you can still submit it.

The selected videos would be used for our LOTTO 649 campaign. This is a non-union project. If your video is chosen, you will be paid $2,500.00 per video.

Permissions:
Submitted videos must have been shot prior to October 14, 2026.
The person who has filmed the video has granted permission for the video to appear in the ad on TV and online.
All talent who appears in the video are cleared and grant permission for the video to be used

Here’s a top line of things to avoid:
No one under 25 and no children of any age in the video clips.
Nothing that could be perceived as appealing to children. This is a bit nebulous, we know, so use your best judgement.
Nothing that comes across as specifically American.
No alcohol is shown in the clip.

Submissions are due ASAP or before: October 28 at 11am EST.

If interested, you must upload your video(s)to be considered to:
https://lotto649ugc.castingcrane.com/

items.text:
🎬 **CASTING CALL – A MISTAKE (Short Film)**

Hi everyone! We're looking for two actors for our upcoming **7-minute short film**, *A Mistake*, shooting in Central Burnaby on **October 29**.

**LOGLINE**
Two friends bond over the struggles of dating and being single while on a hike, but things take an awkward turn when one jokingly suggests they start dating each other and the other doesn't take it well.

**ROLES**

**BEN | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
A bit awkward, literal, and straightforward, with a dry sense of humour. Ben and Sarah were friends in high school but drifted apart after graduation. He's been single for a while and figures he has nothing to lose by jokingly suggesting they start dating, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn.

**SARAH | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
Outgoing and sociable, Sarah works as a schoolteacher and has an easy warmth about her. She's been single for a while and struggles to process or identify what she's feeling, particularly when it comes to relationships. She and Ben were friends in high school but drifted apart before reconnecting after college. The hike serves as a chance for them to catch up.

**PRODUCTION DETAILS**
📍 Location: Central Burnaby, BC
📅 Shoot date: October 29, 2026
💰 Compensation: Volunteer, with demo reel material, photos, IMDb credit, and food provided on set
🎭 Open to UBCP/ACTRA members and non-union performers
📩 Submission deadline: October 20, 2026

**HOW TO APPLY**
Please email your headshot, demo reel (if available), and resume to **amistakeshortfilm@gmail.com**. We are also open to first time actors and those who have had no formal training. 

Use the subject line: **[Your Name] – [Character Name] Audition**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**. Feel free to share with anyone who might be a good fit. Thanks!

177. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück  
am Dienstag, 03.11.2026 – 7:15 Uhr, Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna  

Vortrag: Mag. Thomas Dürrer (Geschäftsführer LSG)  
Rechte, Reichweite, Rückvergütung – die LSG  
Moderation:  Monika Medek 

Was passiert eigentlich mit den Entgelten für die Nutzung von Musik auf Radio, TV, im Web oder in Bibliotheken? Die LSG – Wahrnehmung von Leistungsschutzrechten GmbH – sorgt dafür, dass Interpret*innen und Labels ihren Anteil aus den sogenannten Leistungsschutzrechten erhalten. Thomas Dürrer erklärt bei diesem Impuls, welche Rechte Künstler*innen übertragen können und wie die Verteilung funktioniert.  
©Mag. Thomas Dürrer  

Adresse: Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien

items.text:
# 🎬 CASTING CALL — LAINEY | THE BROS SHOW

**Unpaid Acting Opportunity | South or West London**
## ABOUT THE PROJECT

We're looking for an actress to play **Lainey**, a key character in *The Bros Show* — an independent South London teen sitcom blending chaotic comedy, mockumentary-style filming, friendship, romance and everyday life.

*The Bros Show* follows a group of friends whose ambitions, arguments and ridiculous ideas constantly get them into trouble. The series has a natural, handheld mockumentary style, with improvised-feeling banter, awkward camera moments and plenty of personality.

We're looking for someone who can bring Lainey to life and become part of the show's creative journey.
## 🎭 THE ROLE — LAINEY

**Character age:** 17
**Role type:** Recurring character
**Location requirement:** Applicants must be based in South or West London.

Lainey is confident, witty, flirty, stubborn and fiercely independent. She has a playful side, a sharp tongue and a habit of getting under Aweys's skin just to see how he reacts.

She and Aweys have known each other since childhood. After spending time apart while Lainey worked on herself and built her own life, she returns to New Harbour and reconnects with him and the rest of the group.

Their relationship is full of teasing, competitive banter, playful arguments and genuine affection. She can make Aweys speechless one minute and roast him the next.

But Lainey isn't just a love interest. She has her own ambitions, including music, fashion, styling and art. She's independent, loyal, occasionally difficult to read, and determined to be recognised for who she really is.

**We're looking for an actress who can portray:**
* Confident, natural and expressive acting.
* Quick-witted comedy and believable banter.
* Playful flirting and strong on-screen chemistry.
* A character who can be sweet, stubborn, intimidating and affectionate.
* Genuine emotion when the comedy gives way to more personal moments.

You don't need to be an established professional actor. We're interested in personality, commitment, creativity and the ability to make the character feel real.
## 💇‍♀️ APPEARANCE & STYLE

The character has a specific visual concept:
* White female character with blonde hair.
* Long, layered hair falling past the shoulders.
* Soft waves and a natural, slightly messy finish.
* A relaxed 1990s/Y2K-inspired aesthetic.
* Signature outfit inspiration: an *NSYNC T-shirt and a backwards cap.
* Casual, feminine streetwear that suits her confident personality.

The visual inspiration is Jill from *Party of Five*, with a **“cute but dangerous”** vibe.

Please include recent photographs showing your current appearance when applying. Blonde hair is the intended character look; please state whether your hair is naturally blonde, dyed blonde or would require styling.
## 📍 LOCATION REQUIREMENT

**This casting call is for actors based in South London or West London only.**

Applicants must be able to travel to the filming and rehearsal locations. Please consider your travel arrangements and availability before applying.

Exact meeting points, filming dates and schedules will be communicated to shortlisted applicants.
## 🎥 AUDITION PROCESS

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to perform an audition tape based on a scene titled **“Six Wings and a Reunion.”**

The scene takes place at a chicken shop and a football pitch. It tests the chemistry between Lainey and Aweys through natural conversation, teasing, competitive football banter and a more affectionate moment.

We're looking for a performance that feels natural rather than overly rehearsed. The character should come across as confident and playful without losing her emotional depth.

Further audition instructions and the script will be provided to selected applicants.

Callbacks or a chemistry test may follow, depending on the audition results.
## 📅 AVAILABILITY & COMMITMENT

Please state your general availability for rehearsals and filming when applying.

The role is intended to be recurring, so we are looking for someone who can commit to the agreed filming schedule and communicate reliably.

Filming dates, expected time commitments and the arrangements for future appearances will be discussed before casting is finalised.
## 💷 PAYMENT & EXPENSES

**This is an unpaid independent production.**

There is currently no guaranteed payment or reimbursement for travel, food or other expenses. Applicants should only apply if they are comfortable with these terms.

Any future changes to payment or expenses will be communicated clearly rather than assumed.
## 📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:
1. Your name or preferred professional name.
2. Your age.
3. Your general location — South or West London.
4. Recent photographs showing your current appearance.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous work, if available.
6. Your general availability for filming and rehearsals.
7. A short introduction explaining why you would like to play Lainey.

You do not need professional acting credits to apply.

# 🎬 CASTING CALL — LAINEY | THE BROS SHOW

**Unpaid Acting Opportunity | South or West London**
## ABOUT THE PROJECT

We're looking for an actress to play **Lainey**, a key character in *The Bros Show* — an independent South London teen sitcom blending chaotic comedy, mockumentary-style filming, friendship, romance and everyday life.

*The Bros Show* follows a group of friends whose ambitions, arguments and ridiculous ideas constantly get them into trouble. The series has a natural, handheld mockumentary style, with improvised-feeling banter, awkward camera moments and plenty of personality.

We're looking for someone who can bring Lainey to life and become part of the show's creative journey.
## 🎭 THE ROLE — LAINEY

**Character age:** 17
**Role type:** Recurring character
**Location requirement:** Applicants must be based in South or West London.

Lainey is confident, witty, flirty, stubborn and fiercely independent. She has a playful side, a sharp tongue and a habit of getting under Aweys's skin just to see how he reacts.

She and Aweys have known each other since childhood. After spending time apart while Lainey worked on herself and built her own life, she returns to New Harbour and reconnects with him and the rest of the group.

Their relationship is full of teasing, competitive banter, playful arguments and genuine affection. She can make Aweys speechless one minute and roast him the next.

But Lainey isn't just a love interest. She has her own ambitions, including music, fashion, styling and art. She's independent, loyal, occasionally difficult to read, and determined to be recognised for who she really is.

**We're looking for an actress who can portray:**
* Confident, natural and expressive acting.
* Quick-witted comedy and believable banter.
* Playful flirting and strong on-screen chemistry.
* A character who can be sweet, stubborn, intimidating and affectionate.
* Genuine emotion when the comedy gives way to more personal moments.

You don't need to be an established professional actor. We're interested in personality, commitment, creativity and the ability to make the character feel real.
## 💇‍♀️ APPEARANCE & STYLE

The character has a specific visual concept:
* White female character with blonde hair.
* Long, layered hair falling past the shoulders.
* Soft waves and a natural, slightly messy finish.
* A relaxed 1990s/Y2K-inspired aesthetic.
* Signature outfit inspiration: an *NSYNC T-shirt and a backwards cap.
* Casual, feminine streetwear that suits her confident personality.

The visual inspiration is Jill from *Party of Five*, with a **“cute but dangerous”** vibe.

Please include recent photographs showing your current appearance when applying. Blonde hair is the intended character look; please state whether your hair is naturally blonde, dyed blonde or would require styling.
## 📍 LOCATION REQUIREMENT

**This casting call is for actors based in South London or West London only.**

Applicants must be able to travel to the filming and rehearsal locations. Please consider your travel arrangements and availability before applying.

Exact meeting points, filming dates and schedules will be communicated to shortlisted applicants.
## 🎥 AUDITION PROCESS

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to perform an audition tape based on a scene titled **“Six Wings and a Reunion.”**

The scene takes place at a chicken shop and a football pitch. It tests the chemistry between Lainey and Aweys through natural conversation, teasing, competitive football banter and a more affectionate moment.

We're looking for a performance that feels natural rather than overly rehearsed. The character should come across as confident and playful without losing her emotional depth.

Further audition instructions and the script will be provided to selected applicants.

Callbacks or a chemistry test may follow, depending on the audition results.
## 📅 AVAILABILITY & COMMITMENT

Please state your general availability for rehearsals and filming when applying.

The role is intended to be recurring, so we are looking for someone who can commit to the agreed filming schedule and communicate reliably.

Filming dates, expected time commitments and the arrangements for future appearances will be discussed before casting is finalised.
## 💷 PAYMENT & EXPENSES

**This is an unpaid independent production.**

There is currently no guaranteed payment or reimbursement for travel, food or other expenses. Applicants should only apply if they are comfortable with these terms.

Any future changes to payment or expenses will be communicated clearly rather than assumed.
## 📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:
1. Your name or preferred professional name.
2. Your age.
3. Your general location — South or West London.
4. Recent photographs showing your current appearance.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous work, if available.
6. Your general availability for filming and rehearsals.
7. A short introduction explaining why you would like to play Lainey.

You do not need professional acting credits to apply.

**Please do not send sensitive personal information or your full home address.** If you are under 18, a parent or guardian should be involved in the casting and filming arrangements.
## 🌟 A FINAL NOTE

Lainey is an important character in *The Bros Show*, and we're looking for someone who can bring her personality, humour and individuality to the screen.

If you love comedy, enjoy performing and think you could bring this character to life, we'd love to hear from you.

**Project:** The Bros Show
**Role:** Lainey
**Character age:** 17
**Casting area:** South or West London
**Payment:** Unpaid
**Application:** Send the requested details and photographs by private message.

🎬 **Let's find our Lainey.**

**LOCATIONS WANTED | CASTRATO | JANUARY 2027**

Hi everyone! I’m producing CASTRATO, an independent psychological horror short set in a 1970s boys’ choir conservatoire, and we’re looking for locations.

We’d love leads on old schools, boarding houses, churches, former religious buildings or period properties with any of these spaces:

• An imposing entrance, ideally with a gated driveway
• A reception hall with a large staircase overlooking it
• A dim, worn chapel or prayer room
• A grand choir rehearsal hall with large windows, an organ would be a bonus
• An office with 1970s character and natural light
• A dormitory or room large enough for five beds
• A bare or disused room we could dress as a makeshift hospital room

The attached images are illustrative references to give a sense of what we’re after. We’re open to creative alternatives and spaces we can set dress.

**A property covering several locations would be ideal, but individual spaces are very welcome!**

Filming is planned for **January 2027, exact dates TBC**. We’re working with an independent short-film budget, so please include hire rates where possible, and any filming restrictions.

If you have somewhere suitable or know someone who might, please DM me with photos and the property’s location, or email castratofilm@gmail.com.

Thanks so much! Any leads, shares or advice would be hugely appreciated!

Ruby | Producer, CASTRATO

🚨 **PRESTON & LANCASHIRE — WE NEED YOUR HELP!** 🏚️🎬

-

We're currently looking for **PROPERTY OWNERS willing to support HELP! (2027)**, an independent horror film presented by **AYKAY GP TV in collaboration with Lenico Productions.**

**-**

Got a house, an unusual building, some land, an outdoor space, or access to a unique location that could help bring our story to life? **WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU!**

🎥 **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**

🏠 Houses and residential properties
🏚️ Abandoned or unusual buildings
🌳 Fields, land and outdoor locations
📍 Unique locations around Preston, Lancashire and the surrounding areas!

-

⚠️ **PLEASE NOTE:** HELP! is a voluntary, no-budget production. We're looking for people willing to let us use suitable locations for filming. Every property will be treated with respect, and owners will be kept informed throughout the process.

-

You don't need any experience in filmmaking. Simply having access to a suitable location could make a massive difference to our production!

-

📩 **GOT A LOCATION THAT COULD WORK?**

Get in touch directly with either **@aykaygp** or **@lenico_productions** on Instagram with some information about your property and photographs, if possible.

-

Even if you're unsure whether your location is suitable, don't hesitate to reach out!

🎬 **ONE LOCATION. ONE OPPORTUNITY. ONE STORY TO BRING TO LIFE.**

**-**

**HELP! (2027)**
*AYKAY GP TV × Lenico Productions*

*-*

📢 **PLEASE SHARE THIS POST!** Help us find the perfect filming locations and support independent filmmaking here in Lancashire.

-

#HELP2027 #Preston #Lancashire #IndependentFilm #HorrorFilm #FilmingLocations #AYKAYGPTV #LenicoProductions

Serial Uroczysko.

WROCŁAW

Szukam AKTORÓW ZAWODOWYCH do ról:
1. Janisz – Adam 50 lat. Szef muzeum w Uroczysku. Nie ma wielkiej charyzmy, ale jest sprawnym Urzędnikiem, kocha to, co lubi. Terminy: 23.10
2. Witold (62) - najlepszy przyjaciel Sławomira. Kochanek Teresy. Terminy: 24.10
3. Teresa Bogucka (60) - żona Sławomira, chce się go pozbyć. Zdradza go z Witoldem. Terminy: 24.10, 27.10, 29.10 - trzy dni zdjęciowe.

Zgłoszenia proszę wysyłać na adres mailowy:

natalia.wroclaw@studioabm.com.pl

W zgłoszeniu proszę zamieścić (imię i nazwisko, miejsce zamieszkania, aktualna fotografia, numer telefonu, wizytówka aktorska, nazwa szkoły aktorskiej link do demo/selftape lub innej scenki aktorskiej)

What do casting directors REALLY notice when you walk into a dance audition?
We’re bringing award-winning Pearson Casting to Liverpool for an exclusive Audition Technique for Dancers Intensive!

Experience a mock professional dance audition, learn choreography and receive honest, constructive feedback from the other side of the casting table.

Discover what casting directors look for, how you come across in the room, what makes you memorable and why getting the choreography wrong isn’t always the biggest issue.

Plus, a Q&A with Pearson Casting, giving you the chance to ask those all-important industry questions.

With credits including SIX, Operation Mincemeat, Starlight Express, RENT and High School Musical, this is an incredible opportunity for North West performers to learn directly from an award-winning international casting team.

Monday 7th December | Liverpool

3-hour intensive | £25

No job on the line. Just the opportunity to learn, make mistakes and grow.

Bookings: https://bookwhen.com/wirraltowestend

This workshop adheres to CDG guidelines and is not an audition.

**CASTING CALL — TWO ADULT LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Father John and Michel-César** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**FATHER JOHN — Male, playing age 50s**
A strangely attractive priest who runs the boys’ orphanage. Charming yet immediately unsettling, Father John has peculiar habits, nervous twitches and a menacing presence even when smiling. We’re looking for an actor who can embrace his strangeness without becoming cartoonish, creating discomfort through small gestures and changes in expression.

**MICHEL-CÉSAR — Male, playing age 60s**
A prestigious French choir director with a warm, almost grandfatherly presence. Meticulous about order and devoted to his choir, Michel initially feels kind and trustworthy. Gradually, subtle shifts reveal something darker beneath that warmth. We need an actor whose performance allows the unease to creep up on the audience rather than being obvious from the start.

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Actors or agents should email:
* A headshot
* Age and location
* A CV and/or showreel link

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

CASTING CALL: Singer / Actor / Performer
Company: Midnight Creative

Pay: $300 per day

Job Type: Paid Performance Opportunity

Work Location: South Florida

Job Description

Midnight Creative is seeking talented singers, actors, and performers to join our growing roster of immersive theatrical productions.

Our shows combine live theater, dramatic storytelling, music, and audience interaction to create unique entertainment experiences.

We are looking for versatile performers with strong stage presence, expressive acting abilities, and the confidence to captivate an audience through both musical performances and spoken monologues.

Opportunities are available across multiple productions, including Edgar Allan Poe: The Musical, Edgar Allan Poe Speakeasy, and other immersive theatrical experiences.

Responsibilities

* Perform scripted monologues, dramatic scenes, and/or original musical numbers, depending on the production and assigned role.

* Bring characters to life through expressive acting, vocal delivery, and compelling storytelling.

* Learn and memorize scripts, dialogue, and music within designated preparation periods.

* Engage audiences in an immersive theatrical environment.

* Collaborate with fellow cast members and the production team.

* Attend required rehearsals, training sessions, and performances.

* Maintain professionalism, punctuality, and reliability throughout each production.

What We’re Looking For

* Strong acting skills and confident stage presence.

* Ability to deliver engaging, emotionally compelling spoken monologues.

* Strong vocal ability for musical roles (all vocal ranges welcome).

* Excellent memorization skills and the ability to learn material quickly.

* Clear diction, vocal projection, and expressive character interpretation.

* Ability to take direction and adapt to different characters and production styles.

* Experience in musical theater, dramatic theater, cabaret, or immersive performances is a plus.

* Reliable, professional, and comfortable performing in front of live audiences.

Please note: Not all roles require singing. We welcome applications from experienced actors, vocalists, and versatile performers. Casting assignments will be based on individual strengths and production needs.

Compensation

$300 per performance day.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send the following materials to gio@rockstarbeer.com:

* Performance résumé (if available).

* Headshot or recent photograph.

* Acting reel, spoken monologue, or vocal performance video (if available).

Email Subject: Casting Submission – Singer / Actor / Performer

Selected candidates may be invited to audition with a prepared spoken monologue, musical selection, or both, depending on the role.

MOVIETIME KW 42/2026

HASTA LA VISTA BABY, 2 Ö FILM DOKUS INKL INTERVIEWS UND KINDERBUCHVERFILMUNGEN

Zwei interessante wie auch unterschiedliche Film Dokus made in Austria starten mit ATMOSPHERE und WELLEN WENDE aktuell im Kino. Mit den Machern dieser Filme, Erwin Wagenhofer und Josephine Ahnelt konnte Sarah Fuchs jeweils ein Gespräch führen.

Zwei Kinderbuchromane lassen die Herzen der Jüngsten mit BIBI BLOCKSBERG - TOTAL VERHEXT und einem weiteren Remake von EMIL UND DIE DETEKTIVE höher schlagen. 

Vor 35 Jahren schlüpfte Arnold Schwarzenegger mit TERMINATOR 2 erneut in die Rolle des Cyborgs und revolutionierte gemeinsam mit Regisseur James Cameron das Action Kino.

Musikalisch untermalt wird diese Sendung mit den bekanntesten Songs aus dem Kino der letzten 80 Jahre.

Mittwoch 14.10.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Hi! I thought I’d share a little tool I built for myself in case it might be useful to others here.

My daughter does auditions, and I found it surprisingly hard to keep track of everything — submissions, audition requests, callbacks, holds, and shoot dates. Things get scattered across emails and messages, and I wanted one place where I could see everything and keep a history of how things were going.

So I built [CastTrack](https://casttrack.vercel.app/).

It’s a simple casting tracker for parents of young performers. I use it to keep track of where my daughter is with each project and to look back at her audition history and stats.

It’s completely free. I’m a web developer, so it was also a fun project to build for my portfolio, and honestly, I just didn’t want to pay for a tool I needed myself. I’m not planning to monetize it.

My daughter currently auditions mostly through Casting Networks, so that’s what I’ve used it with the most, but it should work with other platforms too.

It’s very much a tool I made to solve my own problem, but maybe someone else will find it useful too. If you try it, I’d love to hear what you think or what could be improved!

[https://casttrack.vercel.app/](https://casttrack.vercel.app/)

items.previewDescription: Auditions come and go, and the details disappear into emails, texts and casting sites. CastTrack keeps the story: every audition adds to a growing record of submissions, callbacks, holds, bookings and everything in between — real data to look back on and compare with what is happening now.

items.text:
Hello! 

We are casting for another tourism video filmed out in Kamloops. We are looking for an adventurous couple, approximately 45–60 years old, who have a natural ease, playfulness and convincing chemistry together. We would love to see a couple that can spark off each other, and are able to tease each other in a light hearted way, without taking themselves seriously. 

We’re looking for people who feel:

* Warm, curious, and naturally engaging

* Ready for adventure and enjoy an active lifestyle

* Curious about travel and the people they meet

* Comfortable hiking recreationally

* Relaxed and natural on camera

* One member of the couple must be comfortable driving with a full drivers license 

* Will need a standard American accent

The short video follows a couple through a series of experiences - hiking, biking, wineries, and restaurants. The idea is to showcase that this region has something to offer for everyone; both the adventure seekers and the chill outers. The couple will be reading reviews of the spots as they go along, and find themselves getting curious about what they might discover. 

Details:
- 3 days w/c 19th October
- Day rate range $700-$1000 depending on experience
- Kamloops area, must be able to drive to location

If interested, please complete below submission and email georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS **

For this project, the client is looking for a couple submission only. 

We would love to see you both in frame, side by side, framed from the top of the head to just above chest. 

Please submit:
* Slate
* Scene 1
* Scene 2

**On your slate we would love to see:**
* Name, height, location, union status

**Scene 1**

Describe your last adventure weekend. Where would you go, what activities would you do? What roles did you both play on the trip? Does one of you do the planning, how do you compromise? 

**Scene 2**

Find an online review for any location, coffee shop, restaurant, and read it allowed to your partner. Discuss between you what you think it’ll be like, and you decide to give it a go!

Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

items.summary:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

***On recherche un comédien en vue du rôle principal masculin, 20-25 ans, pour un clip musical étudiant à Angers (Pays de la Loire, France)***
# 
**Le projet** : 

Clip musical appelé « Ok Ok Ok » du groupe "Fleuri Désert"
# 
**Cadre **: 

Projet pédagogique d'étudiants en Bachelor Réalisateur Monteur de l'école Studio M Angers.
# 
**Date du tournage **: 

Samedi 24 octobre 2026, journée et soirée, à Angers 
# 
⚠️ ***non défrayé*** ⚠️

**LE RÔLE **

Rôle principal, muet. Un jeune homme dont la vie lui échappe : il rate un rendez-vous avec une fille, puis un rendez-vous avec un employeur, et chaque échec l'enfonce un peu plus. Il en souffre, et ça doit se voir.
Le personnage met en images les paroles de la chanson. Tout passe par le visage, le corps et les réactions. Le ton est très théâtrale, presque exagéré par moment tout en étant capable de transmettre des émotions forte à d'autre moment. On cherche donc idéalement quelqu'un capable de jouer un personnage désemparé et d'aller loin dans l'expression sans que ça sonne faux.
Pas de danse
# 
PROFIL 

Homme, 20 à 25 ans.
À l'aise avec le jeu expressif et physique. Une expérience en théâtre, impro ou tournage est un plus.
# 
INFOS PRATIQUES

Il faut être disponible toute la journée et la soirée du samedi 24 octobre, à Angers (49).

# CANDIDATURE 

Par mail à [goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628)
***Objet obligatoire : Casting Clip musical*** (car on recherche pour plusieurs projets en ce moment)
Joindre : une photo récente (visage et plein pied), votre âge, votre ville, et si possible un lien vers une vidéo de jeu.
Date limite : 14 octobre 2026

Clap&Light Productions ([goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628))

🎬🎬🎬 MEGA ULTRA PILNE! CASTING! 🎬🎬🎬

EPIZODYSTKI I EPIZODYŚCI – ROLKI / TIKTOK / IG

Szanowni Państwo!

Na środę, 21 października 

poszukujemy epizodystek i epizodystów 

do krótkiej formy komercyjnej realizowanej 
na potrzeby kanałów TikTok i Instagram (IG).

🎥 KOGO SZUKAMY?

✅ Kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 25–50 lat 

✅ Osób polskojęzycznych 

✅ Osób posiadających doświadczenie w pracy przed kamerą

Poszukujemy osób do wielu różnych ról, 
które wcielą się w postaci pracowników 
i klientów marketu.

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE: 500–1000 zł netto

Stawka uzależniona jest od przypisanej postaci i zakresu roli. 
Po zakwalifikowaniu zgłoszonych osób 
do konkretnych postaci skontaktujemy się 
z wybranymi osobami i poinformujemy je 
o proponowanej stawce.

📍 MIEJSCE REALIZACJI: Warszawa

📅 TERMIN: środa, 21 października 

🕘 GODZINY: pierwsza połowa dnia

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Osoby zainteresowane i dyspozycyjne prosimy 
o przesłanie zgłoszenia w wiadomości e-mail 

na adres:  📧 abcastingab@gmail.com

📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭

W zgłoszeniu prosimy wpisać:

• Temat: ROLKI  21. 10
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy oraz zdjęcie całej sylwetki
• Informację o doświadczeniu w pracy przed kamerą
• Linki do materiałów wideo, na których można Państwa zobaczyć i usłyszeć

🎬 Poszukujemy osób do wielu postaci — jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą i jesteś dyspozycyjny/a w środę, serdecznie zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥🤝

items.text:
Ready to unlock your voice, own the screen or stage, and boost your confidence? 🎭🎙️ Enrollment for our Online Voice & Acting Studio is officially open!

We believe that performance training is about so much more than memorizing lines. Whether you are 7 or 80, training your voice and acting skills is about building resilience, developing overall presence, and having a creative joy in a kind, welcoming space.

🎼 Our Philosophy: 
We meet every student exactly where they are. Whether you are prepping for a professional audition, getting ready for a big public speaking event, or just looking to build social confidence, we focus on personal growth and knowledge—never perfection.

🎬 The Lesson Structure:

Fully Customized: Private lessons are tailored around your unique goals and busy weekly routine.

Core Pillars: Every session is designed for your area of focus. Possibly blending vocal mechanics (clarity, breath, and tone) with on-camera techniques (audition/presentation prep, script analysis, and screen presence).

🌟 Meet Your Coach: My journey in the performing arts spans over a decade across theater, competitive audition-based choirs, and 11 years of dance training. Because I am actively pursuing my BFA in Acting at the collegiate level, my coaching is fresh, modern, and perfectly aligned with what the industry looks for today and having amateur performing experience. I translate high-level knowledge into fun, encouraging mentorship where every student feels safe, seen, and celebrated.

➡️ Spaces are intentionally limited to ensure dedicated, individual attention. Tap the link to fill out our quick Google Interest Form and claim your preferred time slot!

📩 Have questions? Feel free to drop a comment or email me directly at umbehauerb@gmail.com!

Google form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfTuOEIngR6dhtABu79XjDlTn7o0isvjE0rC_TY_TUnBiPsGg/viewform?usp=dialog

STAFFING BOSTON CELTICS & BRUINS!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking reliable, enthusiastic, and professional Brand Ambassadors to represent TD Bank at Boston Celtics and Boston Bruins home games at TD Garden in Boston, MA!

Event 1: Celtics

Friday, October 23, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Event 2: Bruins

Saturday, October 24, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Location:

TD Garden

100 Legends Way

Boston, MA 02114

Compensation:

Team Lead — $35 per hour

Brand Ambassadors — $30 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Parking:

Parking reimbursed with receipt.

Attire:

Branded t-shirts will be provided. Wear black pants (no leggings, sweatpants, or ripped/torn jeans) with clean, comfortable white sneakers. Long-sleeved black or white layers may be worn underneath the branded shirt, and black jackets are permitted as needed for colder weather.

Event Details: 

TD Bank is bringing game-day excitement to TD Garden for back-to-back home games featuring the Boston Celtics on Friday and the Boston Bruins on Saturday! Brand Ambassadors will be stationed throughout the exterior plaza and indoor concourse areas, engaging with fans, creating personalized player trading cards, and assisting with interactive games.

Team Lead Duties: 

• Must have experience leading large teams. 

• Oversee staff and coordinate team assignments. 

• Ensure smooth event execution and client communication. 

• Capture event photos and submit recaps.

Staff Duties:

• Assist with event prep, execution, and breakdown to ensure smooth operations.

• Engage with fans, communicate key brand messaging, and guide guests through the activation. 

• Maintain a fun, welcoming, and energetic atmosphere to create memorable fan experiences. 

• Support event activities, manage guest flow, and assist with giveaways.

Staff Expectations: 

We want high-energy, outgoing, and engaging Brand Ambassadors who know how to hype a crowd and create great vibes. You must be punctual, professional, and ready to bring it from start to finish!

Application Process:

To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:

• Availability

• Resume

• Headshot

• Relevant experience

• A brief description of why you're an excellent fit for this role.

Please use "TD Garden - Celtics & Bruins" as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

Mezinárodní filmový festival BRNO16 se řadí mezi nejdéle fungující filmové festivaly v České republice. Od svého založení v roce 1960 se koná nepřetržitě a zároveň patří k nejstarším přehlídkám krátkometrážní tvorby na světě. Představuje široké spektrum krátkých filmů, od hraných a animovaných až po experimentální snímky, a to jak od studentů, tak od profesionálních i neprofesionálních tvůrců. Vedle prestižní filmové soutěže nabízí také bohatý doprovodný program zahrnující výstavy, diskuse a workshopy. Festival každoročně hostí řadu českých i zahraničních osobností, které návštěvníkům umožňují nahlédnout do zákulisí své tvorby a diskutovat o filmech i zkušenostech z filmového prostředí.
___
Plánujete dorazit? 🎬
___
#kinoboxcz #kinobox #pozvánka #festival #brno16

Casting a live table read for a social-justice themed project.  This has a very pro-human rights/anti-exploitation stance, so performers must be comfortable with that as the theme and mission.

Rate $100/day

Dates: 

week of October 19, one individual rehearsal with director, with scheduling flexibility for actors.

Nov 6th 8am-5pm

Nov 9th 8am-5pm

Potential Nov 10th 8am-5pm, (dependent on previous days, so availability here a huge plus!)

For all roles, looking for believability, authenticity and realism to bring these roles to life. While not an on-camera performance, these roles require on-camera subtlety and nuance.

Roles:

**Leslie:** female, mid-60's, the CEO of The Corporation, the spin doctor who easily bends the truth to make the company look good. 

**Greg:** male, 50s-60s, CFO of The Corporation, the accountant to whom people are numbers on a spreadsheet.

**Nico:** male, mid 50's-60's Security Officer for The Corporation, blue collar, former cop who has made a career of following orders and not questioning them.

To submit, please send a headshot, resume and link to sample of your work (monologue, self-tape, demo reel, etc) to CastingHRC@gmail.com, no later than Friday, October 16th. Please confirm availability for the dates.

Beim Interview mit dem Bavarka-Trio im Rahmen unseres Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerbs durften wir besondere Menschen kennenlernen, die nicht nur mit ihrer Musik berühren, sondern auch eine wichtige Botschaft vermitteln.

Gerade in diesen bewegenden Zeiten, in denen die Politik und die Ereignisse im Osten Europas uns alle beschäftigen, setzen sie mit ihrer Musik ein Zeichen für Menschlichkeit, gegenseitigen Respekt und Toleranz. 🙏❤️

Besonders schön: Das Trio hat ein eigenes Lied geschrieben und beim Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerb gesungen. Ein Lied, das von Herzen kommt und eine Botschaft trägt! 🎶✨

📺 Bleibt dran! Schon bald wird der Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerb bei unserem JSW Fernsehen ausgestrahlt. Freut euch auf das Bavarka-Trio und viele weitere tolle Sängerinnen und Sänger!

Musik kennt keine Grenzen – sie verbindet Menschen und schenkt Hoffnung. ❤️🎤

Во время интервью с Bavarka-Trio в рамках нашего благотворительного песенного конкурса мы познакомились с замечательными людьми, которые трогают сердца не только своей музыкой, но и важным посланием.

В наше непростое время, когда события в политике и происходящее в Восточной Европе волнуют всех нас, они своим творчеством несут миру послание человечности, взаимного уважения и терпимости. 🙏❤️

items.text:
We are working with the lovely team at Raw Research casting an exciting ITV x PayPal Christmas campaign, and we’re looking for bubbly, fun-loving families (e.g. adult siblings, adults with their parents, couples with children aged 16+, friends and housemates who love Christmas and go the extra mile to make it memorable. We’re particularly keen to hear from adults in their 40s and 50s - though all ages are welcome.

You might be a couple with children aged 16 or older, adult siblings, or grown-up children celebrating with their parents. Whatever your set-up, we’d love to meet people who enjoy a laugh, love ITV and already have plans for this Christmas.

We are looking for people who are London-based or about 90 minutes outside of London.

Do you have a Christmas dilemma we could help with?
Perhaps your adult child has a new partner joining Christmas lunch and you have no idea what to buy them? Maybe you’re determined to surprise your mum or sibling but have run out of ideas? Or perhaps you want to make a friend’s Christmas extra special and need some inspiration!

We’d ideally spend a day filming at your home, having fun planning presents, putting up decorations and calling ITV for help with your Christmas dilemmas. There may even be a quiz about ITV presenters, so a love of ITV and a willingness to be a bit silly are essential!

Filming - Dates TBC but 5th or 6th OR 9th are 10th of November are likely.

Payment:
£350 per person, per filming day.
£2,000 per person if you appear in the final ad campaign.
£500 per household if filming takes place in your home.
Eligibility:
Everyone taking part must be aged 16 or over. Ideally adults in their 40s and 50s!
Participants must be eligible for a PayPal account and have used PayPal or be familiar with it.
Participants must have no adverse credit history, history of debt or financial vulnerability.
Participants must have no current or previous affiliations with competing financial brands.
Interested? Please contact casting@rawresearch.co.uk, telling us who you’d take part with, what makes Christmas special to you and the Christmas dilemma you’d love help with. Please also send a photo of everyone applying, a simple selfie will do!
Thank you

We meet in Boyle Heights every 1st Thursday of the month at 6pm.

VI SØGER 5 DELTAGERE TIL EN YOUTUBE-VIDEO PÅ SØNDAG!
Er du god til at lyve, fortælle historier og improvisere? Så søger vi dig!

Vi er Chris & Jacob, og vi søger både drenge og piger på 18 år eller derover til en underholdende YouTube-video.

Konceptet:

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres eget liv.

Vi har 5 forskellige historier og 5 runder, hvor vi skal forsøge at matche hver historie med den person, der rent faktisk har oplevet den.

Et eksempel på en runde:

Overskriften er: "Jeg blev fyret fra mit arbejde."

Alle 5 deltagere skal nu fortælle deres egen version af historien om dengang, de blev fyret.

Men der er et twist: Kun én af deltagerne er faktisk blevet fyret og fortæller sin sande historie. De andre 4 skal lyve og finde på deres egen overbevisende forklaring!

Chris og Jacob skal så afhøre jer, stille spørgsmål og forsøge at gennemskue, hvem der taler sandt.

Efter hver runde matcher vi historien med den person, vi tror har oplevet den. Men vi må gerne ændre vores tidligere valg undervejs, hvis en anden deltager pludselig virker mere overbevisende.

Til sidst skal vi have matchet alle 5 historier med de rigtige personer, og så afslører vi, hvor mange vi har gættet rigtigt!

Skal man kunne improvisere?

Du behøver ikke være skuespiller eller verdensmester i at lyve!

Alle deltagere får nemlig de 5 overskrifter tilsendt inden optagelsen, så I har mulighed for at forberede jeres opdigtede historier hjemmefra.

Det er altså ikke ren improvisation. Men I skal selvfølgelig stadig kunne svare på vores spørgsmål og forsøge at overbevise os om, at jeres historie er sand.

Vi søger først og fremmest nogle friske, udadvendte personer, som har lyst til at være med på kamera, kan tage lidt pis på os og ikke er bange for at spille med!

Praktisk info:

Søndag den 18. oktober
Kl. 15.00-18.00
Amager, København

Alder: 18+

Honorar:  Friviligt, ingen betaling.

Vil du være med? Det er til Chris og Jacobs youtube kanal:  [https://www.youtube.com/@ChrisogJacob](https://www.youtube.com/@ChrisogJacob)

Skriv til vores caster Mandarina på 31 49 55 65 med:

- Dit navn og din alder
- Din Instagram
- Mindst én vild, sjov, pinlig eller usædvanlig sand historie fra dit liv

Vi skal kun bruge én historie fra hver deltager til selve videoen, men du må meget gerne sende flere, så vi har noget at vælge imellem!

Det kan være alt fra en fuldstændig vanvittig oplevelse til noget virkelig akavet eller usandsynligt, som faktisk er sket for dig.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra jer!

**STATISTER SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM – DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE**

Til afgangsfilmen *ANGELS*, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi statister af alle typer, køn og aldre til at agere familiemedlemmer/venner til et sølvbryllup.

**Dato:** Torsdag d. 15. oktober

**Tidsrum:** ca. 09.00-19.00

**Sted:** Storkøbenhavn

Lyder det som dig - eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Hvis du er under 18 år bedes du desuden angive navn og kontaktoplysninger på en forælder/værge.

Skriv: FESTGÆST i emnefeltet.

*OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.*

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

Bonjour à tous, 

Pour les besoins de la mini-série « A4 », dédiée aux réseaux sociaux, nous sommes à la recherche d’une comédienne métisse (mélange d’origines) pour interpréter Victoria (Vic’), la 4e personne d’une bande d’amis en coloc. 

VICTORIA (VIC’) : 
Femme, 18-25 ans, souriante, sociable et dynamique. Vic’ est une jeune femme aux multiples facettes. 

📍Tournage sur Lyon 

Si tu penses correspondre au profil, envoie-nous quelques photos et une vidéo de présentation (bande-démo facultative) ainsi que tes informations à : emilie.crepin01@gmail.com 

N’hésitez pas à partager l’annonce autour de vous !

Announcing auditions for:

The Savannah Sipping Society

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

All audition info can be found at [https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/](https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFycU1rOXdWUVQ3NVYwZTd5c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHm2Tb8clJTpxO68zuvsQvksB_no2fy_0RkndZIF5-lmcuKAEritfk1H60_jt_aem_lUoHhYxjNHwOwByN68UZcg)

We are currently looking for up to four actors to participate in our upcoming twilight spooky rides.
Here are the details for the position:

  - Dates: October 22, 23, 24, 29, 30, and 31

  - Hours: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM (2 hours per day)

  - Pay: $50 per day (paid in cash)

  - Location: Silver Lake Railriders, 1381 Village Road, Silver Lake, NH 03875 (behind the Silver Lake Railroad Station)

Schedule & Responsibilities:

  - Station Actor (1): Remains at the station area and yard to haunt the arriving guests.

  - Trail Actors (3): At 4:00 PM, a rail motorcar will drop three actors off at designated acting locations along the route.

  - The Performance: The twilight railbike ride departs at 4:30 PM. Actors will scare guests on their way out and back. The rail motorcar will pick up the trail actors at the end of the run, returning everyone to the station around 6:00 PM for a final scare.

Requirements:

  - Safety rules must be strictly followed: no touching riders and maintain a safe distance from all equipment.

  - All actors (or parents/guardians for minors) must sign a standard liability release prior to participating.

I have created a spreadsheet to help organize and schedule interested actors. You can learn more about us at slrailriders.com.

Best regards,

Hank Walther

Rail Ventures

Silver Lake Railriders

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję kobiet do nastepujących ról:

1.Roksana (19) – młoda, ładna, pracuje w kawiarni jako barmanka/baristka. Dziewczyna z problemami psychicznymi.
Data: 26 i 27.10
Stawka: 1600 zł netto

2.Joanna (37) – przeciętna kobieta z przemocowej rodziny, zaniedbana, wystraszona   
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3. Śledcza (37) – zadbana śledcza, konkretna, rzeczowa.
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4.Iwona (41) – kobieta po stracie dziecka, załamana, rozbita, wrak człowieka. Chorobliwie szczupła i zniszczona problemami.  
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 700 zł netto

Chętne Panie zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

🎬 CASTING CALL!
Hi! I’m Fé from Just Russel 👋

Just Russel is a Belgian brand that creates personalised food for dogs and cats. 🐶🐱

We’re currently looking for new faces in Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and France who enjoy being in front of the camera.

For our videos, we’re looking for people who feel comfortable on camera and enjoy creating fun, natural content.

You don’t need to have a pet yourself, we can provide one for the shoot. 😉 But if you do have a four-legged friend who also enjoys being in front of the camera, they’re more than welcome to join!

The most important thing is that you feel comfortable on camera and with an animal by your side on set.

Would you like to be part of our content?

Just fill in the form and who knows, maybe we’ll see you on set soon! 🎥

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję kobiet do nastepujących ról:

1.Roksana (19) – młoda, ładna, pracuje w kawiarni jako barmanka/baristka. Dziewczyna z problemami psychicznymi.
Data: 26 i 27.10
Stawka: 1600 zł netto

2.Joanna (37) – przeciętna kobieta z przemocowej rodziny, zaniedbana, wystraszona   
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3. Śledcza (37) – zadbana śledcza, konkretna, rzeczowa.
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4.Iwona (41) – kobieta po stracie dziecka, załamana, rozbita, wrak człowieka. Chorobliwie szczupła i zniszczona problemami.  
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 700 zł netto

Chętne Panie zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Throughout October & November, I’m dedicating more time to analog photography and would love to collaborate with artists and event organisers, documenting your performances and events, as well as creating artistic and personal portraits.

Available for performance documentation, event photography, and outdoor analog portrait sessions in Berlin & Hamburg.

Feel free to reach out here or via Instagram @zakharin.photography.

I.Z.

**🎬 CASTING CALL **🎥

**FEATURE FILM CAST DESCRIPTION**

**TERROR IN TIMMONTON**

**An Independent Mystery / Suspense Feature Film**

**Production Company:** R&R Visionary Productions
**Genre:** Mystery / Suspense
**Production Type:** Independent Feature Film
**Union Status:** Non-Union
**Filming Location:** Waterloo / Cedar Falls, Iowa
**Filming Begins:** Summer 2027
**Projected Release:** 2028
**Casting Deadline:** October 31, 2026

**About the Film**

*She survived the nightmare. But what if leaving it behind only led her into another?*

After enduring more than eight years of abuse, Hailee finally escapes her troubled past, only to become the victim of a brutal attack that nearly takes her life.

While recovering in the hospital, she develops an unexpected friendship with a male nurse who offers her the opportunity to leave Arizona and begin a new life.

But her fresh start takes a mysterious turn when she discovers a hidden note behind a bedroom nightstand.

**"If you are reading this, that means I am dead. — Annalise."**

Determined to uncover the truth, Hailee begins asking questions about Annalise. However, the people around her claim to know nothing about the mysterious woman.

As secrets begin to surface, Hailee realizes that her new home may hold a disturbing past—and that some people will do anything to keep the truth buried.

**Compensation and Meals**

This is an **unpaid, volunteer-based independent feature film production**. There is no monetary compensation for acting roles.

Participants will have the opportunity to gain valuable on-set experience, develop their acting skills, build their portfolios, and participate in a full-length feature film.

**Lunch and supper will be provided at no cost to cast members on their scheduled filming days.**

**How to Apply**

Interested actors may submit through **Backstage** or email:

**[rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com](mailto:rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com)**

Please include:
* Your full name and contact information
* The character or role you wish to audition for
* A recent headshot or photograph
* Acting résumé or previous experience, if available
* Your anticipated availability during Summer 2027

**CASTING DEADLINE: OCTOBER 31, 2026**

**JOIN THE CAST!**

R&R Visionary Productions welcomes dedicated, enthusiastic individuals who are passionate about storytelling and independent filmmaking.

Help us bring the secrets, mystery, and suspense of *Terror in *

*Timmonton* to the big screen!

**R&R Visionary Productions**
*Bringing Stories to Life*

Last-minute flashback roles for a scripted thriller short (YouTube, large channel).

BELLA'S MOTHER – Black woman, 50s. Warm, grounded. Little to no dialogue.

BELLA'S FATHER – Black man, 50s. Warm, grounded. Little to no dialogue.

(Casting at least one Black parent; an interracial couple works too.)

→ Thursday, Oct 15, a couple of hours. $100 flat.

THE ROBOT – Woman, 20s, any ethnicity. Plays a humanoid AI out in the real world: still, precise, slightly "off." Movement or dance background a plus.

→ Friday, Oct 16, half day. $200 flat.

Shooting in Los Angeles. Everything provided.

To submit: PM me here on Facebook with a recent photo and the role.

Seeking talent for law firm project - NU - Richmond VA - Self Tapes Required!

Greetings everyone!  NEW PROJECT JUST IN!

Here is what we know / need:

Context:  Law Firm commercial shoot

Location:  Richmond VA area

Shoot day: Wednesday Oct. 21st

Talent Roles:

1. Mom - 35-45 - Any ethnicity
2. Dad - 35-45 - Any ethnicity
3. Child - 8-10 yrs old - Any ethnicity
4. Woman - 50s - Hispanic or African American 

Rate: 

$1,200 adults + 20% agency fee - (1) :30 second spot - usage one year TV/Streaming and paid online VA regional (Richmond, Charlottesville, Fredericksburg, Petersburg markets) 

$700 child + 20% agency fee - (1) :30 second spot - usage same as above 

Travel Stipend: $250 a person (negotiable)

Submission process:

Client has requested a self tape for consideration for these roles.  Here are the instructions:

–Slate first and last name then location

–For any of the family roles (#1-3) - talent should tell us a their favorite story, one happy and one sad, but not too long, just a minute on each. 

–For the individual female role (#4) - talent should do the same as above but not too long so she can act out a scene.  The scene is as follows:  talent is sitting with the attorneys and then hearing the news that they have won the case, so we can see her reaction. She will sit down and then stand up and hug the attorney. 

Note - please feel free to submit as a group as you meet the breakdown for the family roles.  Just ensure that all individuals provide the requested information.

Please send 1 self tape via WeTransfer to [bias@liquidtalentgroup.com](mailto:bias@liquidtalentgroup.com) by 5 pm on Sunday 10/18.  Sooner is better!

**CASTING CALL – PAID AI TRAINING PROJECT**

**Location:** San Marino, CA (near Alhambra)
**Rate:** $25/hour | 8-hour shifts ($200/day)
**Dates:** Ongoing opportunities

Seeking reliable individuals for a paid AI training project involving simple, everyday household activities, such as cooking, chopping vegetables, food preparation, assembling items, and basic DIY tasks.

No acting experience or special skills required! All activities are directed step by step. Simply follow instructions and demonstrate the tasks as requested.

**Requirements:**
* English proficiency is required to understand and follow verbal instructions.
* Must be comfortable on camera.
* Must be able to follow step-by-step directions.
* **This is a physically active role requiring up to 8 hours on your feet, including moving around, sitting, standing, and lifting light objects.**
* All tattoos must be covered.

**To apply:** Email your full name, email address, phone number, and availability to [goldenhourtalent@gmail.com](mailto:goldenhourtalent@gmail.com)** or DM me.**

🎥POSZUKUJĘ GRUPY TANECZNEJ DO TELEDYSKU DISCO! 💃🕺🎶🎥
Cześć! 👋 Szukam 3–4 osób lub większej grupy tanecznej chętnych do wystąpienia w moim nowym teledysku disco polo! 🎤🔥

📍 Miejsce nagrania: Białystok

Najlepiej, jeśli zgłoszą się osoby z Białegostoku lub okolic.

📅 Termin: piątek(wiem,że późno😉)

🎬 Co trzeba zrobić? Zatańczyć do jednej lub dwóch piosenek. Chodzi o krótkie ujęcia taneczne, które zostaną wykorzystane jako przebitki w teledysku.

🎭 Pomysł na występ: planuję taniec w maskach, żeby stworzyć większe show i nadać klipowi wyjątkowy klimat! 😎 Dzięki temu wizerunek uczestników nie musi być pokazywany. Jeśli ktoś będzie chciał wystąpić bez maski i zgodzi się na wykorzystanie swojego wizerunku, również możemy to ustalić.

💰 Występ płatny – wynagrodzenie do uzgodnienia!

📩 Osoby zainteresowane zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej. Ustalimy szczegóły, miejsce, godziny oraz wynagrodzenie.

**LOCATIONS WANTED | CASTRATO | JANUARY 2027**

Hi everyone! I’m producing CASTRATO, an independent psychological horror short set in a 1970s boys’ choir conservatoire, and we’re looking for locations.

We’d love leads on old schools, boarding houses, churches, former religious buildings or period properties with any of these spaces:

• An imposing entrance, ideally with a gated driveway
• A reception hall with a large staircase overlooking it
• A dim, worn chapel or prayer room
• A grand choir rehearsal hall with large windows, an organ would be a bonus
• An office with 1970s character and natural light
• A dormitory or room large enough for five beds
• A bare or disused room we could dress as a makeshift hospital room

The attached images are illustrative references to give a sense of what we’re after. We’re open to creative alternatives and spaces we can set dress.

**A property covering several locations would be ideal, but individual spaces are very welcome!**

Filming is planned for **January 2027, exact dates TBC**. We’re working with an independent short-film budget, so please include hire rates where possible, and any filming restrictions.

If you have somewhere suitable or know someone who might, please DM me with photos and the property’s location, or email castratofilm@gmail.com.

Thanks so much! Any leads, shares or advice would be hugely appreciated!

Ruby | Producer, CASTRATO

We are casting for people who have lost money to online fraud

We are looking for people aged 18 to 35 who have been caught out by online fraud and are willing to tell

their story on camera. It is for a short documentary film for a bank, about how these scams can affect your life.

Shoot is half day either on 4th or 5th of November

Fee £500 paid to you , plus travel within M25 of London 

Where it will be shown Social media and across the web

We are looking for people who 

• You have lost money to online fraud. It could be a fake investment, crypto, a trading course, a

seller who never delivered, a romance scam or something else. How it happened and how much

you lost don't matter.

• We are based in and shooting in London, but happy for you to travel to us to take part.

• You are willing to talk on camera about what happened. You don't need any experience. We

want real people, not actors.

• Partners – if this has affected you both, please tell us how, we may have you both along.

This film is aimed to show how convincing these scams are.

Please fill out this form to apply: https://form.jotform.com/262875842920365

If you have any questions please email us hello@casscasting.com with the title ONLINE FRAUD

PART 1........

About 13 years ago  I was on program to minister in song at the Beverly Garland Hotel in North Hollywood Ca. As we started to the event i had a really bad asthma attack. I couldn't sing. When they called my name, I started walking down towards the stage. I asked God to give me something. When I reached the stage God started pouring into me. It was so overwhelming and when it was over I couldn't remember anything. As I sat down my husband said how did this happen? Where did it come from? I said I have no idea. By the grace of God someone filmed it and "Im Still Yo Mama was birth!

PART 2 COMING SOON!
HOW DID IT GO FROM SPOKEN WORD TO A PLAY?
I'm Still Yo Mama

Historia opowiada o dziewczynce w spektrum autyzmu, która szuka akceptacji wśród rówieśników.Film zawiera elementy fantastyki - do której szukamy aktorów.

**WARSZAWA**

**29 października**

**Film fabularny – DUBLERKA 70+**

**Stawka 1100 zł**

** **

Do nowego filmu fabularnego, do którego zdjęcia ruszają pod koniec października, **poszukujemy dublerki aktorki (wiek 70+)**. Szukamy pani o wzroście ok. 168 cm i rozmiarze ubrań L. Specyfika sceny wymaga pełnej nagości, przy czym ujęcia będą realizowane bez pokazywania wizerunku (twarzy).
